questions.text: Tell me about the furniture you have in your home. Is there a piece that is your favorite?
Tell me about how you use your furniture on a typical day. What kinds of things do you do with your furniture?
Tell me about the furniture that you had in your childhood home. Was there anything different from the furniture that you have today?
People often have appointments for different things. Tell me about the kinds of places you go for different appointments.
What kinds of things do you do when you make appointments? Tell me what you exactly do when you make these appointments.
Tell me about an appointment you remember from your childhood. Maybe you visited a doctor, the dentist, or a new school. What were your impressions? How did you feel?
Sometimes, funny or surprising things happen during an appointment. Tell me about a memorable appointment you had in the past. What happened?
Can you describe for me one of the countries or cities you've visited? What does it look like? And what are the people like there?
I like to travel to Montreal, Canada. Please ask me three or four questions about Montreal.
Describe for me your first trip to another country. When was the trip? Where did you go? Who did you go with? What did you do?
Sometimes, something out of the ordinary happens while traveling. Tell me the story of a surprising or unexpected experience on a trip, starting with when and where you were traveling.
Tell me some of the places you like to travel in your country and why you like going there.
Tell me about some of the trips that you took in your youth. Where did you go? Who did you go with? And what did you see or do?
Tell me about one travel experience you had that was unforgettable. Start with when this happened, where you were, and who you were with.
Tell me about the geography in your country. Are there any mountains? Are there seashores and lakes?
Tell me about popular outdoor activities in your country. Do people go hiking, biking or swimming? What do people typically do outdoors?
Tell me about an early memory of your country's geography. Perhaps you visited a special place or an important natural landmark.
Can you describe a friend or a family member you see often? Who is he or she? What is he or she like?
Tell me about the last time you got together with your friends or family. Tell me everything you did that day from beginning to end.
Tell me about a special event or a holiday you celebrated with your family or friends.
Someone in your family is going on vacation, and you have agreed to take care of their responsibilities at home. Call your relative and ask three or four questions to get the information you need.

When you arrive at your relative's house, the door is locked and the key is not where it is supposed to be. Call your relative's hotel and leave a message explaining the situation. Give two or three options to resolve the problem.
Have you ever agreed to do something for friends or family and then couldn't do it? Tell me what you agreed to do, what happened, and how it was resolved.
Tell me about a restaurant you often visit. What kind of dishes does it serve? Why do you like going there?
I also like to go to restaurants. Please ask me three or four questions about the restaurant I like.
Tell me about the banks in your country. What do they typically look like? Where are they usually located?
Tell me about a bank you remember from your childhood. What was it like? How was it different from banks today?
Tell me about a problem you had that involved a bank. Maybe the bank was closed or made a mistake. How did you solve it?
You want to invite another couple for dinner. Ask your family members three or four questions to find out the best day and time.
On the day of the dinner party, one of your family members has become ill. Call your friend, explain what happened, and propose two or three suggestions.
Have you ever changed a plan because someone in your family asked for help? Tell me all the details of that story.
What kinds of music do you listen to? Who are some of your favorite musicians or composers?
I play the violin in an orchestra. Please ask me three or four questions about this activity.
When and where do you listen to music? Do you listen to the radio? Do you go to concerts? Tell me about the different ways you enjoy music.
When did you first become interested in music? What kind of music did you listen to when you were younger? How has your interest changed until now?
You indicated in the survey that you like to go to the movies. Tell me about the type of movies you like to see.
Tell me about what you normally do when you go to the movie theater. What do you do before and after the movie?
I'd like to know about the last time you went to the movies. Tell me everything that happened that day, including what you did before and after the movie.
Tell me about your first experience of surfing the internet. What did you do? How has your internet usage changed over the years?
What are some issues people talk about regarding the internet? What are their concerns and why are they a problem?
You indicated that you stay at home for vacations. Who are the people you like to see and spend time with on your vacation?
Describe exactly what you did during the last vacation you spent at home, from the first day to the last day.
Tell me about an unusual, unexpected, or satisfying experience you had while at home on vacation. Why was it so memorable?
Tell me about some places people in your country like to spend their free time. Do they visit parks, beaches or other places?
I usually have free time on weekends. Please ask me three or four questions about what I do in my free time.
You want to get two tickets to see a performance during your vacation. Call the box office and ask three or four questions to get tickets.
On the day of the performance, you are very sick. Call your friend, explain the situation and offer two different options to resolve it.
Have you ever bought tickets or made a reservation but had to cancel because of an unexpected incident? Tell me about that experience.
You would like to buy an MP3 player. Call your friend and ask three or four questions about the MP3 player he or she is using.
You borrowed your friend's MP3 player but broke it by accident. Call your friend, explain the situation, and give two or three alternatives.
Tell me about an experience with a device that broke or was not working properly. What was the problem and how did you deal with it?
Let's start the interview now. Tell me a little bit about yourself.
Tell me about your job. What do you do, and what is a typical day at work like for you?
Tell me about a challenging project or problem you had at work. What happened and how did you handle it?
How has the way people work changed compared to when you first started working?
Describe your neighborhood. What is it like, and what kinds of places are nearby?
Have you ever had a problem in your home, like something breaking or a leak? What happened and how did you fix it?
How have parks in your country changed over the years? What are they like now compared to the past?
What do you do to stay healthy? Tell me about your exercise or diet routine.
What health issues do people in your country worry about these days? Why?
Tell me about a piece of technology you use every day. How do you use it?
How has technology like smartphones changed the way people communicate compared to ten years ago?
Some people say AI and smartphones cause problems in society. What do you think the concerns are?
Tell me about recycling in your country. How do people separate their trash at home?
How has recycling changed in your country compared to when you were a child?
Describe an important holiday in your country. What do people usually do on that day?
Tell me about a memorable holiday you spent with your family. What happened?
Tell me about public transportation in your city. How do people usually get around?
Tell me about a time you had a problem while using public transportation.
Describe the hotels in your country. What are they usually like?
Tell me about a memorable hotel you stayed at. What made it special?
Where do you usually shop, and what is your shopping routine like?
How has shopping changed compared to the past? Do you shop online more now?
You want to book a hotel for your next trip. Call the hotel and ask three or four questions about the rooms and services.
When you arrive at the hotel, they say your reservation does not exist. Explain the situation to the front desk and suggest two or three solutions.
Have you ever had a problem with a reservation? Tell me what happened and how it was solved.
You want to buy a new smartphone. Call the store and ask three or four questions about the phone you want.
The new phone you bought stopped working after one day. Call the store, explain the problem, and suggest two or three solutions.
You want to see a movie with a friend this weekend. Call your friend and ask three or four questions to make plans.
You arrive at the theater, but the tickets you booked are for the wrong day. Explain the problem to your friend and offer two alternatives.
A new park just opened near your home. Call the park office and ask three or four questions about it.
